id: \rIvy: Hello \PN. I've been expecting you. On that table there is the ball that I want Professor Oak to look at. Please take care of it.
en: \rIvy: Hello \PN. I've been expecting you. On that table there is the ball that I want Professor Oak to look at.  Please take care of it.
it: \rIvy: Ciao \PN. Ti stavo aspettando. Su quel tavolo c'è la Ball che voglio far esaminare al Professor Oak.  Abbine cura, mi raccomando.

id: \rI heard you were also interested in the league our islands have. The closest Gym would be on Mikan Island.
en: \rI heard you were also interested in the league our islands have. The closest Gym would be on Mikan Island.
it: \rHo sentito che ti interessa anche la lega delle nostre isole. La Palestra più vicina è sull'Isola Mikan.

id: \rIvy: I heard you were also interested in the league our islands have. The closest Gym would be on Mikan Island.
en: \rIvy: I heard you were also interested in the league our islands have. The closest Gym would be on Mikan Island.
it: \rIvy: Ho sentito che ti interessa anche la lega delle nostre isole. La Palestra più vicina è sull'Isola Mikan.

id: \rIvy: You won the Orange League? Impressive.
en: \rIvy: You won the Orange League? Impressive.
it: \rIvy: Hai vinto la Lega Orange? Notevole.

id: \rWe work on this island with Professor Ivy.
en: \rWe work on this island with Professor Ivy.
it: \rLavoriamo su quest'isola con la Professoressa Ivy.

id: \rIvy: That is the GS Ball. Please take good care of it.
en: \rIvy: That is the GS Ball. Please take good care of it.
it: \rIvy: Quella è la GS Ball. Abbine molta cura, mi raccomando.

id: \rI'm so glad you came to get it. It's been exhausting taking care of it.
en: \rI'm so glad you came to get it. It's been exhausting taking care of it.
it: \rSono così felice che tu sia venuto a prenderla. Prendersene cura è stato sfiancante.
